svg.title: Pulse response and neuronal gate fractions
svg.desc: Original single-cell calculation. A 1 ms inward current-density pulse starts at 1 ms. The 2 µA/cm² case is subthreshold in this experiment; 10 µA/cm² produces a spike. Right: activation m, availability h and potassium gate n use solid, dashed, dotted curves. Gates remain in [0, 1].
